basis: Explicit user-agreed engineering delivery criterion; module-by-module implementation and exceptional-path review, formal regression, six matching-source gate groups, verified complete development candidate; no known unclosed permission/data/core-flow code blocker. This is a review grade, not a measured success rate or a score derived from test counts.
pendingUserAcceptance: real microphone/loopback and three voice providers
real external model/MCP/database and multi-device colleague connections
real Win32/UIA/ConPTY and Windows device matrix

limitations: No promise of zero future defects or unconditional reliability.
Go and race each have 28 explicitly skipped tests; 8 desktop tests use existing !race build constraints and only passed the ordinary suite.
Go vulnerability scan has one module-only advisory and zero reachable findings; frontend build retains a bundle-size warning.
Unsigned development candidate only; signing, installation and external release were not performed.
The reusable 8-hour resource observation default is a short diagnostic; the candidate-bound user record requires 72-hour mixed workload and 14 days with at least 3000 valid core operations.
